# Process — Fixture Clinic

## Step 1 — Enquiry

The patient describes what they need.

## Step 2 — Triage

Routine, hygiene and emergency requests are separated.

## Step 3 — Booking

An appointment is offered from the available slots.

## Step 4 — Confirmation

A confirmation is sent with the date, time and clinician.

## Step 5 — Follow-up

A reminder is sent the day before.
